verified_guarantees: The published commit has the requested base as its sole parent and all 16 changed paths are task-allowed.
All four source/dependency hashes and the canonical aggregate in the frozen manifest match the exact clean checkout.
The retained inventory contains exactly 180 distinct API-set names, numerically justifying a bounded query/system-contract ceiling above 180.
The ctypes declaration matches the installed Microsoft SDK apiquery2.h signature and calling convention: PCSTR, UINT32 buffer capacity, PWSTR, UINT32 pointer, and HRESULT through WinDLL.
The adapter requires S_OK, validates the returned count including the null terminator, and restricts output to a bounded canonical DLL basename.

The session consumes before dispatch, reserves before native calls, requires an exact durable-intent acknowledgement per name, counts attempted backend calls before invocation, emits no partial result, and refuses same-session replay.
Name, call, duration, output-buffer, and serialized-result bounds are explicit; an external owned-process deadline remains required for actual synchronous native calls.
